title: Vitexicarpin suppresses malignant progression of colorectal cancer through affecting c-Myc ubiquitination by targeting IMPDH2.
authors: Ding, Xiao-Jing; Cai, Xue-Mei; Wang, Qian-Qian; Liu, Ning; Zhong, Wei-Long; Xi, Xiao-Nan; Lu, Ya-Xin
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物vitexicarpin通过靶向IMPDH2影响c-Myc泛素化抑制结直肠癌，虽涉及蛋白互作但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅用分子对接辅助，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is the second most common cause of cancer-related mortality and is characterised by extensive invasive and metastatic potential. Previous studies have shown that vitexicarpin extracted from the fruits of Vitex rotundifolia can impede tumour progression. However, the molecular mechanisms involved in CRC treatment are still not fully established. PURPOSE: Our study aimed to investigate the anticancer activity, targets, and molecular mechanisms of vitexicarpin in CRC hoping to provide novel therapies for patients with CRC. STUDY DESIGN/METHODS: The impact of vitexicarpin on CRC was assessed through various experiments including MTT, clone formation, EDU, cell cycle, and apoptosis assays, as well as a tumour xenograft model. CETSA, label-free quantitative proteomics, and Biacore were used to identify the vitexicarpin targets. WB, Co-IP, Ubiquitination assay, IF, molecular docking, MST, and cell transfection were used to investigate the mechanism of action of vitexicarpin in CRC cells. Furthermore, we analysed the expression patterns and correlation of target proteins in TCGA and GEPIA datasets and clinical samples. Finally, wound healing, Transwell, tail vein injection model, and tissue section staining were used to demonstrate the antimetastatic effect of vitexicarpin on CRC in vitro and in vivo. RESULTS: Our findings demonstrated that vitexicarpin exhibits anticancer activity by directly binding to inosine monophosphate dehydrogenase 2 (IMPDH2) and that it promotes c-Myc ubiquitination by disrupting the interaction between IMPDH2 and c-Myc, leading to epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) inhibition. Vitexicarpin hinders the migration and invasion of CRC cells by reversing EMT both in vitro and in vivo. Additionally, these results were validated by the overexpression and knockdown of IMPDH2 in CRC cells. CONCLUSION: These results demonstrated that vitexicarpin regulates the interaction between IMPDH2 and c-Myc to inhibit CRC proliferation and metastasis both in vitro and in vivo. These discoveries introduce potential molecular targets for CRC treatment and shed light on new mechanisms for c-Myc regulation in tumours.
abstract_zh: 背景：结直肠癌（CRC）是癌症相关死亡的第二大常见原因，其特征是广泛的侵袭和转移潜力。既往研究表明，从蔓荆子（Vitex rotundifolia）果实中提取的蔓荆子黄素（vitexicarpin）可阻碍肿瘤进展。然而，其在结直肠癌治疗中涉及的分子机制尚未完全明确。目的：本研究旨在探讨蔓荆子黄素在结直肠癌中的抗癌活性、靶点及分子机制，希望为结直肠癌患者提供新的治疗策略。研究设计/方法：通过多种实验评估蔓荆子黄素对结直肠癌的影响，包括MTT、克隆形成、EDU、细胞周期和凋亡实验，以及肿瘤异种移植模型。采用CETSA、无标记定量蛋白质组学和Biacore鉴定蔓荆子黄素的靶点。利用WB、Co-IP、泛素化实验、IF、分子对接、MST和细胞转染研究蔓荆子黄素在结直肠癌细胞中的作用机制。此外，我们分析了TCGA和GEPIA数据集及临床样本中靶蛋白的表达模式和相关性。最后，通过伤口愈合、Transwell、尾静脉注射模型和组织切片染色，在体外和体内证明蔓荆子黄素对结直肠癌的抗转移作用。结果：我们的研究结果表明，蔓荆子黄素通过直接结合肌苷单磷酸脱氢酶2（IMPDH2）发挥抗癌活性，并通过破坏IMPDH2与c-Myc之间的相互作用促进c-Myc泛素化，从而抑制上皮-间质转化（EMT）。蔓荆子黄素通过在体外和体内逆转EMT，阻碍结直肠癌细胞的迁移和侵袭。此外，这些结果通过结直肠癌细胞中IMPDH2的过表达和敲低得到验证。结论：这些结果表明，蔓荆子黄素通过调节IMPDH2与c-Myc之间的相互作用，在体外和体内抑制结直肠癌的增殖和转移。这些发现为结直肠癌治疗引入了潜在的分子靶点，并揭示了肿瘤中c-Myc调控的新机制。
